HOW TO PLAY.

Created by uniquegames · Four worlds, twelve stages, four guardians.

Break every colored brick. Keep the ball above your paddle. You start each run with three lives.

Controls

Desktop: ← / → or A / D to move. Mouse movement also works. Space launches the ball. P or Escape pauses.

Mobile: Slide your finger left or right in the control area below the board to move without covering the paddle. You can also drag on the board. Tap either area to launch. Use the pause button to take a break.

Bricks & combos

Normal bricks break in one hit. Armored bricks take two or three hits. Steel bricks cannot break and do not count toward clearing a level. Bonus bricks can drop a boost.

Break consecutive bricks before touching the paddle to build a combo up to ×4.

Four worlds · twelve stages

Levels 1–3: Meadow, an easy introduction. Levels 4–6: Ocean, learn switch gates and gently moving rows. Levels 7–9: Snow, add two-hit armor. Levels 10–12: Space, combine familiar mechanics with a moderate final challenge. Each world has two normal stages and a guardian at Level 3, 6, 9 or 12. The scenery, animation and colors change after each world.

Bosses take 6, 9, 9 and 12 hits respectively. Hit the glowing section; the weak spot moves left → center → right when its health pips run out. Shielded sections reflect the ball. Difficulty rises gradually from easy to medium, with a small increase for the final two stages.

Stars & run missions

Each cleared level earns 1–3 stars based on lives lost during that level: zero losses = 3 stars, one = 2, two or more = 1. Catching extra lives does not erase losses. Your highest star rating and best score for each level are saved separately.

Every new run has three missions: collect 3 boosts, reach a ×4 combo, and clear any level without losing a life. Open Pause to check progress. Missions carry across levels and reset on Play Again or a new run.
